title: Signature Spellbook: Chandra: card flavor text

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker who offers up her greatest regrets to be consumed by flames.

events.summary: Engulfed by flames, Chandra opens her heart and offers her greatest regrets to be consumed by the inferno.
events.quote: As the flames engulfed her, Chandra opened her heart and offered up her greatest regrets to be consumed by the inferno.
